remarks:
Excellent investment opportunity in the heart of Randolph, NY! This well-maintained brick duplex offers two income-producing units and is conveniently located close to schools, shopping, restaurants, and all village amenities.

The upper apartment features 3 bedrooms (1 currently used as laundry room) and 1 full bath, open kitchen and living room with plenty of storage. The  lower unit offers 1 bedroom, large, walk-in closet, living room, and kitchen, and 3/4 bath. The property has been thoughtfully maintained, including professionally repointed brickwork and two newer furnaces, 1 newer hot water tank. 

Tenants pay their own gas and electric, with separate gas and electric meters for each apartment. Public water and sewer are currently paid by the seller. Both units include a stove and refrigerator owned by the seller. Any washers and dryers located on-site belong to the tenants and are not included in the sale.

Additional features include a full basement, ample off-street parking, and an extra lot that provides additional space and flexibility. Situated along a high-visibility, heavily traveled corridor, the property offers excellent exposure and potential for future development opportunities. The additional lot may provide possibilities for expanded use, additional parking, or other ventures, subject to municipal approvals and zoning requirements.

Whether you're looking to expand your investment portfolio or explore mixed-use possibilities, this property offers outstanding potential in a desirable village location. Don't miss this opportunity to own a solid brick multi-family property with strong rental appeal and future possibilities in Randolph, New York!
